title: Small cars…
content: This may have nothing to do with mallworld but just dreams in general but does anyone else have dreams where ur in or driving a small car like almost like a Mario cart car or those mini cars kids get? I’ve had plenty of dreams driving in a regular vehicle but I’ve noticed I’ve had this weird dream before where I was in a little car but in my dream world it was completely normal to have this little car. This may only be me but just wanted to see 😂 cause I’ve also had plane dreams where the plane is either really huge inside like a movie theater with a ton of seats, and I’ve also had a dream where the plane was extremely tiny with no roof. Idk my dreams are insane but it’s also really hard to get to where I’m trying to go when I’m in these tiny cars/planes ect.
